Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │      ├── clip_l.safetensors
│   │      └── t5xxl_fp16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │      └── flux1-dev.safetensors
│   └── 📂 vae/
│          └── ae.safetensors
```

## Report issue

Note: please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud will be updated after the stable release; nightly-supported models may not be included yet, please wait for the next stable release.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

RA fierce Viking female warrior standing full-body against a dark, smoky studio background. She has long, braided blonde hair with loose strands, intense blue eyes, and bold war paint smeared across her face. Her expression is cold, determined, and battle-hardened. Her body is athletic and scarred, marked with runic tattoos across her torso and arms.
She wears rugged Norse warrior attire made of leather, fur, and layered cloth: a leather bra top, fur-trimmed skirt panels, worn belts with metal buckles, arm bracers, and heavy fur-lined boots. Animal pelts hang from her waist and legs. She holds short daggers in both hands, relaxed but ready for combat.
Cinematic lighting with dramatic shadows, ultra-realistic textures, detailed skin, fabric, fur, and metal.
Dark fantasy realism, gritty and grounded. High contrast, moody atmosphere, shallow depth of field.
Shot like a character poster from an epic historical fantasy film. 8K resolution, ultra-detailed, sharp focus.
